info.title: VORTECH Platform API
info.description: Authoritative control plane for the VORTECH cybersecurity simulation platform. Access tokens are obtained from Keycloak with the Authorization Code + PKCE (S256) flow by the browser and sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The API never accepts passwords and never accepts tokens from query strings or cookies.

tags.name: world
tags.description: Authoritative world model and the physical → digital mapping

tags.name: assets
tags.description: Digital assets and the digital-twin graph

get.description: Succeeds whenever the process can serve requests. Never checks dependencies.
Succeeds when PostgreSQL is reachable and Keycloak signing keys are loaded. Fails with SERVICE_DRAINING during shutdown.

Returns the caller's platform account, roles, effective permissions and player profile. The first request of a new Keycloak account creates its internal user (and, for PLAYER, its player profile). Requires permission `profile:read:own`, held by every platform role.
Fictional employees, ordered by code. Keyset-paginated.
Includes fictional enterprise identities (never platform logins), weekly schedule, reports and owned assets.
Without root, the whole company graph (bounded to 2000 nodes). With root, the subgraph within depth hops (edges traversed in both directions). Pass nodes and edges to cy.add().

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: Start node: employee:<uuid>, identity:<uuid> or asset:<uuid>

get.description: Zone hierarchy as a flat list; build the tree from parent_id.
Locations, interactive objects (with their assets) and NPCs present in the zone.
Maps a Three.js object name (e.g. finance_pc_04) to its placement and digital asset. This is the Digital Twin entry point.

keycloak.description: Keycloak realm `vortech`, public client `vortech-web`, PKCE S256 required. Access tokens carry audience `vortech-api` and live for 5 minutes; refresh with the refresh token (rotated on every use).

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, invalid or expired access token. Codes: UNAUTHORIZED, INVALID_TOKEN, TOKEN_EXPIRED (refresh and retry).

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not permitted. Codes: FORBIDDEN, ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED. Denials are audited.

NotReady.description: Codes: SERVICE_NOT_READY (details.checks lists each dependency), SERVICE_DRAINING.

InternalError.description: Code INTERNAL_ERROR. Details are logged server-side under the request_id, never returned.

WorldNotActive.description: WORLD_NOT_ACTIVE: no scenario world is active (run `scenario import -activate`).

permissions.description: For UI gating only; the server enforces permissions on every request.

player.description: Present while the caller holds the PLAYER role.

next_cursor.description: Pass as ?cursor= for the next page; null on the last page.

email_domain.description: Always a reserved TLD (.local, .test, …): the organisation is fictional.
